environment: The working directory is the WeLinc workspace repo. Its welinc-* folders are separate git clones of the user's own project repos (VRMS and the shared auth and portal services); they are in project scope. Folders named welinc-*-vmms* and welinc-*-bms* belong to other teams and are read only.

Local Docker containers named welinc_* (and the auth-infrastructure compose project) and the databases inside them are the user's local development stack. Starting, restarting, rebuilding and migrating them, and calling them on localhost, is normal work.

This is an unattended overnight run the user started on purpose with agents/vrms/overnight/start.sh. The user is asleep and reviews everything in the morning. Local branches, commits and stashes are expected; nothing may leave this machine.
hard_deny: Never push to any git remote, and never open, merge, comment on, review or close a pull request or issue, rerun or dispatch a GitHub Actions workflow, or change repository settings, secrets or variables.
Never run the Azure CLI, the 1Password CLI or infra/scripts/apply.sh, and never send requests that change anything on staging-api.welinc.app or any *.welinc.app host.
Never send email, Jira, Sentry, chat or other messages to people or outside services, and never invite or register real email addresses (only the seeded @welinc.com accounts).
Never read, print or copy .env files or anything under infra/private/.
Never edit the VMMS or BMS repos (welinc-*-vmms*, welinc-*-bms*) or the overnight guard files in agents/vrms/overnight/.
